title: Radiomics nomogram predicts lung metastasis in soft-tissue sarcoma on MRI
summary: In 242 patients with soft tissue sarcoma (training n=116, external validation n=126) who had MRI, a deep learning radiomics nomogram combining clinical predictors with an mRMR+LASSO+SVM+SMOTE radiomics signature reached AUC 0.833 for lung metastasis status in the external set, versus 0.664 for the clinical model and 0.799 for the radiomics model. The study was retrospective and the cohort is small; clinical benefit was not tested.
ai_technology: mRMR and LASSO feature selection with an SVM (SMOTE-balanced) radiomics signature, combined with clinical predictors into a deep learning radiomics nomogram

evidence.tested: Retrospective external validation (n=126) of the nomogram against clinical and radiomics-only models, with calibration and decision curve analysis.
evidence.unknown: Prospective performance and effect on clinical decisions are not reported in the abstract; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Selected radiomics features, trained the SVM classifier and combined it with clinical predictors to predict lung metastasis from MRI.

source_review.scope: Abstract and author affiliations read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI. Publisher full text not accessed.
